meta.title: Kiran AB — Tech Lead & Full-Stack Engineer
meta.description: Tech Lead with 9+ years building core banking and enterprise systems with Java Spring Boot, ReactJS, AWS and Kafka. Currently leading ORION at ANZ.

profile.name: Kiran A B
profile.tagline: I design and ship scalable banking-grade systems — from Kafka event pipelines to the React screens bankers use every day — and I like leaving the codebase better than I found it.
profile.availability: Open to Tech Lead / Senior Engineer roles
summary: Accomplished Tech Lead with 9+ years of full-stack development experience, driving innovation in core banking and enterprise systems.
Strong command over Java Spring Boot, ReactJS, cloud technologies (AWS, Kafka), and modern DevOps practices.
Extensive hands-on experience in Agile methodologies and SAFe framework implementation.
Proven ability to lead high-performing teams while delivering scalable, production-grade applications.
Continuous learner with demonstrated expertise in emerging technologies and architectural best practices.

experience.role: Software Engineer — Tech Lead, Designer & Full Stack Developer
experience.summary: In the Institutional Banking department, I hold the roles of Tech Lead, Designer, and Full Stack Developer. Primarily responsible for developing and maintaining core banking web-based applications tailored for Institutional Bankers.
highlights: Architecting and developing backend microservices using Java Spring Boot with focus on scalability and performance
Designing and implementing responsive frontend solutions using ReactJS
Managing DevOps operations including CI/CD pipeline optimization and deployment automation
Mentoring junior developers and conducting technical code reviews to maintain code quality
Collaborating with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions
Implementing cloud-based solutions using AWS services for improved scalability and reliability
achievements: Led ORION project refactoring, modernizing legacy banking systems with the latest technology stack
Optimized application performance resulting in 40% reduction in response times
Implemented event-driven architecture patterns using Kafka for real-time data processing
Established best practices for microservices development and deployment

experience.summary: Full-stack software developer responsible for gathering requirements from stakeholders and developing solutions with rich UI and user-friendly interfaces. Core focus on API integration and functionality development according to specifications.
highlights: Gathered requirements directly from stakeholders and translated them into working software
Built rich, user-friendly interfaces across multiple mission-critical applications
Focused on API integration and functionality development according to specifications
Supported global operations across Volvo Trucks, Volvo Buses and Mack Trucks
achievements: Awarded SPOT Award for dedication and commitment to excellence
Awarded Volvo IT Star Award for technical excellence and innovation
Runners-Up in Hackathon 2017 and Hackathon 2018 (Volvo IT Ignite)
Developed multiple mission-critical applications supporting global operations

projects.name: ORION
projects.overview: ORION is a pivotal core banking application within ANZ Institutional Banking undergoing comprehensive refactoring, rebuilt from the ground up using advanced technology stacks.
responsibilities: Tech Lead and Designer for the project, setting technical direction and standards
Architected microservices-based backend using Spring Boot and AWS services
Implemented Kafka-based event streaming for real-time transaction processing
Spearheaded development of user stories and technical implementation planning
Overseeing DevOps process including CI/CD pipeline improvements and cloud deployment
Contributed to knowledge sharing initiatives, enhancing team productivity
Demonstrated ownership of tasks from development through production deployment
Mentored junior developers on microservices architecture and cloud best practices
projects.impact: Resulted in minimal defects and established this as the reference architecture for future ANZ projects.

projects.name: NAMS
projects.org: Volvo Group — New After Market Service Integration System
projects.overview: NAMS is a centralized integration system for Volvo aftermarket operations. NAMS Information Center (NIC) provides comprehensive visibility of NAMS operations, clients, and subsystems.
responsibilities: Frontend development using ReactJS with focus on performance and usability
Designed and implemented visually appealing graphical user interfaces
Developed real-time status monitoring and alerting systems for subsystems
Proficiently handled API development and seamless front-end integration
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure system reliability
projects.impact: Gave operations teams live visibility into NAMS clients and subsystems for the first time.

projects.name: Vehicle Data Administration (VDA+)
projects.overview: Central Volvo system providing unified access to vehicle information across Volvo Trucks, Volvo Buses, and Mack Trucks. Enables read/write access to VDA data with capabilities for vehicle data modification, VIC card printing, and report generation.
responsibilities: Frontend development using Angular 4 with focus on data handling and user experience
Seamlessly integrated APIs and implemented functional components per specifications
Designed Angular structures and models for organized application architecture
Directly liaised with stakeholders for requirements gathering and implementation
Ensured high code quality and maintainability standards
projects.impact: Unified vehicle data access across three brands into a single, maintainable application.
